The cost: when the scene ends, cross 3 Stamina boxes immediately that cannot be recovered until a Full Rest. You survived. The body pays later.
at_the_table: When Stamina would reach Broken: holds at 1 box. For rest of scene: no single hit below 1 box. Scene end: cross 3 Stamina (recoverable only on Full Rest). Once per session. Declare immediately when Broken threshold is reached.

requires.text: Any two Body Gated Feats, Strength or Agility 5+, Legendary tier, and a story marker: you carry a Wound Scar

name: Uncanny Reflexes
prerequisite_text: Agility 5+, Evasive Mastery, Legendary tier
text: Once per session, negate any single attack targeting you entirely — no roll needed, no pool cost. Declare after the attack roll has been made and before damage is applied. The attack simply does not connect. No explanation is required in the fiction, but one usually emerges naturally: you were somewhere else, the angle was wrong, luck intervened at the finest possible margin.
at_the_table: After attacker’s roll, before damage: declare negation. Attack has no effect. No Reaction required, no Deflect roll, no pool cost. One use per session. Cannot negate area effects that do not require an attack roll.

name: Masterwork
prerequisite_text: Overclock or Modular Design, Expert Role at Veteran tier, Intellect 4+, Veteran tier
text: Between sessions, create or designate one item as your Masterwork. Work with the GM to define a single unique rule for the Masterwork item — something it does that no standard item of its type can do. The Masterwork cannot be replicated and cannot be confiscated permanently (you can always rebuild it given one Task Block and available materials). You may have only one Masterwork at a time.

name: Ghost Step
prerequisite_text: Shadow Step, Stealth rank 4+, Agility 4+, Veteran tier
text: Once per scene, become completely undetectable for one round — no roll, no opposed check against you can succeed. You cannot attack or take obviously loud actions during this round. After the round, normal Stealth applies. Additionally, twice per session, reroll any failed Stealth check and take the higher result. Declare before the GM describes the consequence.

requires.text: Shadow Step, Stealth rank 4+, Agility 4+, Veteran tier

name: Zero-Day
prerequisite_text: Neural Overload or Adaptive Countermeasures, Net Diver at Veteran tier, Veteran tier
text: Once per session, identify and exploit an unknown vulnerability in any networked system — security rating is irrelevant, countermeasures are bypassed, and access is immediate. The intrusion succeeds automatically. The GM determines what is available inside the system; you determine what you do with the access. After the session, the vulnerability is patched — this Feat cannot be used on the same system twice.

name: Trauma Specialist
prerequisite_text: Pharmacology or Surgical Precision, Medic Role at Veteran tier, Intellect 4+, Veteran tier
text: Once per scene, clear the Broken condition from one ally without a Full Rest — requires one uninterrupted minute of treatment and a Survive Check vs DC 14. On success: the ally is restored to Injured range (boxes 11–14 unmarked) and clears one Condition. On overage 3+: they are restored to Hurt range instead. This is the non-magical equivalent of the Channeler Role’s Step 5 restoration ability.

name: Master Investigator
prerequisite_text: Sharp Eye or Lore Master, Observe and Knowledge as Focus Skills, Intellect 4+, Veteran tier
text: Once per scene, reconstruct a past event from physical evidence without a roll. The GM narrates what happened as if you witnessed it directly. You may then ask three follow-up questions the GM must answer honestly based on what evidence could plausibly reveal. The event can be as complex as the evidence supports — there is no mechanical scope limit.

requires.text: Sharp Eye or Lore Master, Observe and Knowledge as Focus Skills, Intellect 4+, Veteran tier

name: Resolve Incarnate
prerequisite_text: Still Water, Serenity 4+, Heroic tier, and a story marker: you carry a Soul Scar
text: Once per session, when your Resolve would reach Broken, it holds at 1 box instead. You remain fully functional for the rest of the scene — no penalties, no incapacitation — at 1 box. After the scene ends, the pool registers as Broken for recovery purposes. You have not avoided the breaking. You have deferred it until the crisis is over.
at_the_table: When Resolve would reach Broken: holds at 1 box. Fully functional for rest of scene. After scene: registers as Broken (requires recovery). Once per session. Does not reset the pool — recovery proceeds normally after the scene.

requires.text: Still Water, Serenity 4+, Heroic tier, and a story marker: you carry a Soul Scar

name: Warden of the Group
prerequisite_text: Rallying Cry, Morale 4+, Veteran tier
text: Your Lead action becomes a Free Action once per round. You may Lead and use your primary Action (Attack, cast a Power, press a social action) in the same round without splitting your Action economy. You lead and fight at the same time — the people around you benefit from your presence without it costing the party your combat contribution.
at_the_table: Lead: Free Action once per round. May be used in addition to your normal Action allocation. Normal Lead mechanics apply. Does not affect Lead used as a Rallying Cry (which is still once per encounter).

name: Unbreakable
prerequisite_text: Resolve Incarnate, Warden of the Group, Legendary tier
text: Your Resolve holds at 1 box twice per session instead of once. Additionally, once per session, any one ally within Near range who would reach Resolve Broken may substitute your Serenity score for their own on the triggering roll — the roll that caused their Broken. They roll d20 + your Serenity. You do not make this roll; it is their roll with your Serenity. Your presence is itself a resource.
at_the_table: Resolve holds at 1 box: two uses per session (not one). Once per session: one ally in Near range uses your Serenity score (not their own) for one Spirit roll. They still make the roll. Both effects are session resources that reset independently.

name: Ironclad Argument
prerequisite_text: Compelling Voice, Persuade rank 4+, Morale 4+, Veteran tier
text: Your Persuade checks cannot be countered by a simple opposed roll. An opponent who wishes to actively resist must first spend an Action and succeed on a Willpower Check (DC equals your Persuade roll result) before they may roll against you. Once per session, one Persuade check is treated as having achieved the maximum possible result regardless of the actual die roll — declare before rolling.

requires.text: Compelling Voice, Persuade rank 4+, Morale 4+, Veteran tier

name: Untouchable Reputation
prerequisite_text: Command Presence, Reputation 3+, Heroic tier
text: Your Reputation score adds directly to your social Deflect threshold — the passive defense against social attacks. Instead of 10 + Serenity, your social Deflect is 10 + Serenity + tier bonus + Reputation. At Novice, with Reputation 3 and Serenity 3, your social Deflect threshold is 16 — any social attack roll of 16 or lower passes over you without damage. You have become difficult to reach.
at_the_table: Social Deflect threshold: 10 + Serenity + Reputation (instead of 10 + Serenity). Passive, always on. Applies to all social attack rolls (Press actions). Does not affect supernatural social attacks unless they function as Social Actions.

requires.text: Command Presence, Reputation 3+, Heroic tier

name: Perfect Liar
prerequisite_text: Master Deceiver, Acuity 4+, Veteran tier
text: Your deliberate lies cannot be detected by any mundane means. Period. Truth-detection that relies on reading behavior, micro-expression, heartbeat, voice stress, or any observation of you as a person fails when you choose to deceive. Once per session, you may also make one statement undetectable even to supernatural scrutiny that would normally pierce mundane deception. Outside that one use, supernatural truth-detection still functions.
at_the_table: Mundane lie detection: auto-fail against you. Once per session: one statement bypasses supernatural detection too. Outside that one use: supernatural detection normal. Must be actively choosing to deceive — honest statements are just honest statements.

name: Social Supremacy
prerequisite_text: The Right Word, Morale 4+, Heroic tier
text: In social conflicts where you clearly and unambiguously outrank, outrepute, or socially outclass the target — and no supernatural ability is involved on either side — you may resolve the conflict in your favor without a roll. The GM retains final authority on what constitutes clear outclassing. This is not available against equals or near-equals. It is available when the social gap is so obvious that rolling would be theater.
at_the_table: GM may call this available when social disparity is clear and unambiguous. No roll. Outcome in your favor. Cannot be used against social equals. Cannot be used when supernatural social abilities are active. GM always has final call.

name: Legendary Presence
prerequisite_text: Untouchable Reputation, Reputation 4+, Legendary tier
text: Once per session, your name and reputation precede you in a way that reshapes the encounter before it begins. All NPCs present begin at the most favorable attitude their nature permits toward someone of your reputation. Enemies who hate what you stand for may still be hostile — but they are hostile while knowing exactly who you are, which changes everything. This is not a mind control effect. It is the consequence of being genuinely legendary.
at_the_table: Once per session: at scene start, all NPCs begin at their most favorable attitude consistent with their nature. Enemies hostile by nature remain hostile. All NPCs know who you are. Applies to the opening social state, which then evolves normally.

requires.text: Untouchable Reputation, Reputation 4+, Legendary tier

name: The Long Game
prerequisite_text: Shadow Broker, Perfect Liar, Legendary tier
text:
Once per campaign arc (not per session), reveal that you have been operating several steps ahead. Name one specific outcome of the current scene that you have been engineering since before it began. The GM cannot contradict it unless the fiction makes it literally impossible — if you say you had someone bribed, they were bribed. If you say you had an escape route prepared, it exists. The move you reveal must be something your character could plausibly have arranged given their capabilities and access. You were always five steps ahead.
Design Summary
at_the_table: Once per campaign arc: name one pre-arranged outcome of the current scene. GM cannot contradict if physically plausible given character’s capabilities. Must be declared at a dramatically appropriate moment. Cannot retroactively contradict established facts already confirmed in the fiction.

name: Last Bastion
prerequisite_text: Guardian at Veteran tier or above
text: While any ally is at the Injured or Broken threshold, you gain DR 2 on all incoming damage. If two or more allies are Injured or Broken, DR increases to 4. The Guardian fights hardest when there is the most to lose.

name: Frenzy
prerequisite_text: Striker at Veteran tier or above
text: When your Stamina pool drops below half its maximum, you gain +2 to all Attack rolls. This bonus increases to +3 when Stamina drops to box 13 or higher (Injured threshold). This is not voluntary — it activates automatically. Frenzy is always on when the condition is met. It cannot be suppressed.

name: Phantom
prerequisite_text: Sharpshooter at Veteran tier or above
text: Once per scene, after making a ranged attack, you may immediately move up to 2 range bands in any direction as a free action. This movement does not trigger Contested Zone penalties.

name: Bone Crusher
prerequisite_text: Brawler at Veteran tier or above
text: Your unarmed strikes and improvised weapons count as Standard weapons (+2). Once per scene on a given target, when you hit with an unarmed strike and deal 3+ overage, the target makes an opposed Toughness roll or is Stunned until the end of their next turn, at no additional cost.

name: War Cry
prerequisite_text: Warden at Veteran tier or above
text: Once per scene, you may spend 2 Resolve to make a War Cry as an Action. All allies within Near range gain +2 to their next Attack roll this round. The bonus does not stack with other rally bonuses but overrides them if higher.

name: The Listener
prerequisite_text: Seeker at Veteran tier or above
text: Once per scene, by spending 1 minute in quiet observation of an object, person, or location, you may ask the GM three yes/no questions about its supernatural history — what has happened here, what touched it, and what remains. This is broader than Ask the Dark and does not require Resolve.

name: The Debt Web
prerequisite_text: Broker at Veteran tier or above
text: Once per session, you may declare that any single NPC (that you have previously interacted with) owes you a favour without previously establishing this fictionally. The GM determines what the favour is based on the character's history and motivation. You cannot use The Debt Web on the same NPC twice in the same campaign. The Debt Web cannot create debts from enemies or characters with reason to actively oppose you.

name: Burn the Asset
prerequisite_text: Chameleon at Veteran tier or above
text: Once per session, you may sacrifice one Cover Story permanently and deliberately. In exchange, the GM introduces one significant piece of information, access, or favour from the identity you have been building — as if the Cover Story had been successfully maintained long enough to earn a major result. The identity is gone afterward.

name: Arcane Warrior
prerequisite_text: A Combat Specialty and a Magical Specialty, Veteran tier
text: Once per round, you may cast a PL 1 or 2 Power as a free action immediately before or after a melee attack, paying the normal Mana cost. The cast does not use an Action. The magic and the steel land in the same moment.

name: Terrible Authority
prerequisite_text: A Combat Specialty and a Social Specialty, Seasoned tier
text: Your combat reputation precedes you. When making an Intimidate roll, you may substitute your Attack Ability for the Social roll's Ability. You fight the social battle the way you fight everything else.

name: Battle Meditation
prerequisite_text: A Combat Specialty and a Spiritual Specialty, Seasoned tier
text: Once per scene, spend 1 Resolve to enter Battle Meditation as a free action. For that round, all your Attack rolls gain +2 and you are immune to Fear effects. The calm and the violence occupy the same space.

name: The Complete Operative
prerequisite_text: Chameleon and a Magical Specialty, Veteran tier
text: Your Cover Story now includes a false Power Source and Specialty — when opponents attempt to identify your magical abilities (via Observe, Analyze, or magical detection), your Cover Story presents a different set of Powers and a different Specialty than the real ones.

requires.text: Chameleon and a Magical Specialty, Veteran tier

name: The Living Legend
prerequisite_text: Orator or Confidant, and Warden or Anchor, Legendary tier
text: Once per session, your personal presence resolves a social conflict without a roll — not through Persuade or Intimidation, but simply by arriving and being who you are. The GM determines the scale (one NPC, one organisation, one faction). The effect is genuine capitulation, not mechanical Charm. Your reputation and your spiritual gravity have become one thing. The Living Legend works only in situations where your reputation could plausibly precede you.

requires.text: Orator or Confidant, and Warden or Anchor, Legendary tier

name: Empathic Warrior
prerequisite_text: Martyr and a Combat Specialty, Veteran tier
text: When an ally within Close range is hit in combat, you may use your Reaction to make a free attack against the attacker at −2. Shared pain becomes shared purpose. Empathic Warrior and Reflected Pain (Martyr ability) can trigger in the same round.

requires.text: Martyr and a Combat Specialty, Veteran tier

name: Abjurer’s Authority
prerequisite_text: Belief 3+, Magic Overlay
text: When your Abjure roll succeeds with overage 5+, the supernatural entity gains Removed (Spirit) for the rest of the session — not just the scene. This is a significant escalation from the normal rule, which suppresses for the scene. Additionally, Abjure costs 1 fewer Resolve box than normal (minimum 1). You have refined the authority behind the act. Without the Channeler Role, this Feat is how you gain Removed (Spirit) on overage 5+, and you remain limited to one Abjure per scene.
at_the_table: Abjure with overage 5+: entity gains Removed (Spirit) for session (not scene). Abjure costs 1 fewer Resolve (min 1). Both effects apply on the same successful Abjure. No change to the Abjure roll itself.

steps.text: Abjure opens at Seasoned tier, so this Step gives nothing yet.
As written above.
The session-long effect triggers at overage 4+.
Triggers at overage 3+.
The entity also loses one Special for the session.

name: Cantrip Access
prerequisite_text: Intellect 2+ or Belief 2+, Magic Overlay
text: You gain access to a single Level 1 Power with no Mana cost — a cantrip. You cannot Surge it. You cannot add Effects to it. The specific manifestation is defined when you take this Feat: a flicker of fire, a spark of light, a small levitation, a whisper across distance. The effect is minor and defined. This is the first step on the warrior-to-mage path: one small repeatable magical act, earned through training rather than identity.
at_the_table: One specific Level 1 Power, defined at Feat acquisition, usable at no Mana cost. No Surge. No Effects. GM approves the specific manifestation. This is not a general casting ability — it is one specific thing you can do.

steps.text: As written above.
A second Level 1 Power, defined the same way.
You may Surge these Powers.
A third Level 1 Power, and you may add Effects.
Each can be cast at PL 2 by paying its Mana.

name: Channel Access
prerequisite_text: Belief 2+, Magic Overlay
text: You gain access to a single Level 1 Healing Power, paying full Mana cost. You cannot Surge it. The effect is limited: the healing roll unmars up to 2 boxes from the target’s chosen pool. This is the fighter who has learned to lay hands — not channel miracles, not perform divine acts, but offer a trained, earnest act of healing that costs real resources and produces real results.
at_the_table: One Level 1 Healing Power available. Full Mana cost. No Surge. Unmarks up to 2 boxes from one pool (target’s choice). Requires a healing roll against DC 15. One defined manifestation, chosen when Feat is taken.

steps.text: As written above.
You may also choose one Level 1 protection Power.
You may Surge these Powers.
Your Healing Power can also remove one Condition.
Your Healing Power can be cast at PL 2 by paying its Mana.

name: Combat Conditioning
prerequisite_text: Caster or Channeler Role, Strength or Agility 2+
text: Your physical Surge ceiling increases by 1 box when using Combat (Melee) or Combat (Ranged) skills — you can commit one more Surge box than your tier normally allows. Additionally, once per encounter, use a physical Maneuver as a Free Action (no Stamina cost, no Mastery Floor required) immediately after completing a successful Cast or Channel action.

steps.text: Once per encounter, after a Cast or Channel action, +1 to your next physical attack.
Once per encounter, make a Maneuver for 1 Stamina as a Free Action after a Cast or Channel action.
As written above.
Twice per encounter.
Once per round.

requires.text: Caster or Channeler Role, Strength or Agility 2+

name: Countermind
prerequisite_text: Willpower 2+
text: Once per encounter, when you are the target of a Power, you may interrupt the resolution with an opposed Willpower check against the caster’s cast roll — declared after the cast roll is made, before the effect resolves. On success, the Power fails entirely and produces no effect. On failure, the Power resolves normally. This is not a dodge; it is mental rejection.
at_the_table: When targeted by a Power: declare interrupt. Make d20 + Willpower vs caster’s cast roll. Success: Power fails with no effect. Failure: Power resolves normally. Once per encounter. Cannot Countermind area effects if you are not the primary target.

steps.text: Once per encounter, +2 to Deflect against a Power that targets you.
As written above.
Twice per encounter.
You may protect one ally in Close range instead of yourself.
Once per round.

name: Divine Intervention
prerequisite_text: Belief 2+, Magic Overlay
text: You may now use Healing Powers up to Level 2, paying full cost. You receive no Channeler discount and cannot take the Channeler Role. Your healing is genuine in this range — you can restore meaningful capacity, clear Hurt boxes, address Poisoned or Bleeding conditions. The divine source answers when you call. It is simply not your primary relationship.
at_the_table: Healing Powers up to Level 2. Full cost. No Channeler discount. Cannot take the Channeler Role while this Feat is held. Available from Level 9.

steps.text: One Level 1 Healing Power, paying full cost.
Any Level 1 Healing Power, paying full cost.
As written above.
Also Level 1 and 2 protection Powers.
Healing Powers up to Level 3.

name: Martial Training
prerequisite_text: Caster or Channeler Role, Strength or Agility 2+
text: Gain Combat (Melee) or Combat (Ranged) as a Focus Skill (your choice) even if it was not selected at creation. Your Deflect calculation may now use the higher of your Agility Score or Willpower Score — whichever is naturally higher from your build. You are no longer considered untrained in physical combat for the purpose of Maneuver access.

steps.text: As written above.
+1 to your chosen Combat skill.
You ignore the first armor penalty on casting and movement.
One free Maneuver per scene.
+2 to your chosen Combat skill.

requires.text: Caster or Channeler Role, Strength or Agility 2+

name: Power Access
prerequisite_text: Intellect 2+ or Belief 2+, Magic Overlay
text: You may now use Powers up to Level 2, paying full Mana cost and Surge costs with no discount. You receive no Level Discount of any kind. You cannot take the Caster or Channeler Role while you hold this Feat — your relationship with magic is deliberate practice, not innate identity. You are the warrior-mage: real capability, real cost, never the efficiency of a dedicated caster.
at_the_table: Powers up to Level 2 available. Full Mana and Surge costs — no discount. Cannot take the Caster or Channeler Role while this Feat is held. If those Roles are already held, consult GM for conflict resolution. Available from Level 9.

steps.text: Choose one Level 1 Power and cast it, paying full Mana.
Any Level 1 Power, paying full Mana and Surge.
As written above.
Powers up to Level 3, paying full cost.
One chosen Power costs 1 less Mana, minimum 1.

name: Precision Caster
prerequisite_text: Any Magical Specialty, Intellect 2+ or Belief 2+
text: When one of your Powers would affect an area, you may designate up to three creatures within the effect as excluded — they receive no damage, no Condition, and no effect even if physically within the area of effect. You must name the exclusions before the roll is made. This is the mark of a caster who controls their power with surgical precision.
at_the_table: Before rolling an area Power: name up to three creatures as excluded. Exclusions receive no effect. Must be declared before the roll. Does not affect the Power’s cost or roll.

steps.text: Exclude 1 creature from your area Powers.
Exclude up to 2 creatures.
As written above.
Exclude up to 5 creatures.
Exclude anyone you choose.

requires.text: Any Magical Specialty, Intellect 2+ or Belief 2+

name: Unshakeable Faith
prerequisite_text: Belief 2+, active spiritual commitment (narrative)
text: +2 to all Abjure rolls and Spirit rolls made against supernatural sources. Fear DCs from supernatural sources are reduced by 2 for you — what frightens others does not touch you the same way, because you carry something with you that the supernatural cannot easily reach. The narrative prerequisite is not a formal religious requirement — it is a genuine conviction of any kind that the GM acknowledges.
at_the_table: +2 to all Abjure rolls. +2 to Spirit rolls vs supernatural sources. Supernatural Fear DCs reduced by 2 for you. Permanent. Passive. Requires ongoing narrative justification — if the character loses their faith, this Feat may be suspended at GM discretion.

steps.text: As written above.
+3 to Abjure rolls.
Supernatural Fear DCs reduced by 3 for you.
Allies in Close range gain +1 against supernatural fear.
You can’t be Frightened by supernatural sources.

requires.text: Belief 2+, active spiritual commitment (narrative)

name: Power Unleashed
prerequisite_text: Power Access, Intellect 4+ or Belief 4+, Heroic tier+
text: You may now use Powers up to Level 4, paying full cost. You also gain one Level Discount point — a single reduction to Mana costs that does not stack with Caster discounts and applies to your highest-cost cast per scene. You still cannot take the Caster or Channeler Role. At this tier your magic is undeniably real — limited and costly, but real. This is the ceiling of the warrior-mage path within the Feat system.
at_the_table: Powers up to Level 4. Full cost minus 1 Mana on one cast per scene (the highest-cost one). Still cannot take the Caster or Channeler Role. Available from Level 13.

name: Arcane Supremacy
prerequisite_text: Power Unleashed or any Mastery-tier Magical Specialty Feat, Legendary tier+
text: Once per session, cast any Power you know at any Level with no Mana cost. Surge costs still apply if you choose to Surge. This is the warrior-mage’s single moment of unrestricted magical expression — the culmination of a career spent practicing something you were told was not yours. You were wrong. The cost (Surge, if any) remains because commitment to power is its own price.
at_the_table: Once per session: cast any known Power at any Level, 0 Mana cost. Surge costs apply if declared. One use resets each session. Cannot exceed Level 5 regardless of this Feat.

requires.text: Power Unleashed or any Mastery-tier Magical Specialty Feat, Legendary tier+

name: Channel Mastery
prerequisite_text: Divine Intervention, Belief 4+, Heroic tier+
text: You may now use Healing and Protection Powers up to Level 4, paying full cost. You gain one Level Discount point — one Mana reduction on your highest-cost healing or protection cast per scene. You still cannot take the Channeler Role. Your faith is genuine enough that the source answers with real power. The conversation is real. It is simply not the central relationship of your identity.
at_the_table: Healing and Protection Powers up to Level 4. Full cost minus 1 Mana on one cast per scene (the highest-cost qualifying cast). Cannot take the Channeler Role. Available from Level 13.

name: Power Surge Mastery
prerequisite_text: Active Magical Specialty, Intellect 4+, Veteran tier+
text: Your Surge costs for all Powers are reduced by 1 Mana box, to a minimum of 1. This stacks with the Caster Role at Veteran tier (which reduces the Surge cost on your primary cast school by 1). A dedicated Caster who takes this Feat becomes notably more resource-efficient — the combination represents mastery of the cost structure of magical power.
at_the_table: All Surge costs reduced by 1 Mana box (min 1 per Surge box). Stacks with the Caster Role at Veteran tier on the relevant school. Permanent. Applies to all schools of casting.

requires.text: Active Magical Specialty, Intellect 4+, Veteran tier+

name: The Perfect Theory
prerequisite_text: Precision Caster, Intellect 5+, Legendary tier+
text:
Once per session, your next Power automatically hits every intended target and misses every intended exclusion, regardless of any rolls. Declare all targets and all exclusions. The effect resolves. No attack roll, no defense, no Deflect. Surge costs still apply. This is the Theorist’s ideal: a Power executed so precisely that chance becomes irrelevant.
SPIRIT FEATS — Belief · Morale · Serenity — Faith, courage, and spiritual authority
at_the_table: Once per session: next Power auto-hits all declared targets, auto-misses all declared exclusions. No attack roll. Defenders cannot Deflect or Defend. Surge costs apply. Declare before resolving.

name: Arcane Rebound
prerequisite_text: Countermind, Willpower 4+, Heroic tier+
text: When your Countermind check succeeds, you may redirect the countered Power back at the original caster at half potency. The original attack roll is used against the caster’s own Deflect — no additional roll is made. Damage or effects are calculated at half overage (round down). The caster is struck by their own reflected Power.
at_the_table: On successful Countermind: use the original cast roll vs caster’s Deflect. Overage at half value (round down). No additional roll. The reflected effect uses the same Power type, Effect, and source as the original.

name: Radiant Authority
prerequisite_text: Abjurer’s Authority, Belief 5+, Legendary tier+
text: Once per session, your Abjure automatically succeeds against any supernatural entity — no roll required. The entity gains Removed (Spirit) for the session. No opposed check, no Willpower contest, no chance of failure. Against Legendary-tier entities (major demons, gods, elder things), this may only be used once per campaign arc — the entity’s power eventually reasserts. Against anything below Legendary tier, once per session.
at_the_table: Once per session: Abjure with no roll. Automatic success. Target gains Removed (Spirit) for session. Against Legendary-tier entities: once per campaign arc only. GM defines what qualifies as Legendary-tier in the active Genre.

name: Iron Body
prerequisite_text: Combat Conditioning, Strength or Agility 4+, Heroic tier+
text: Your physical pool (Stamina) maximum increases by 3 boxes permanently. When both Stamina and Mana (or Resolve) pools are active in the same round, you may split Actions between them freely — using one pool for a Cast action and another for a Combat action in the same round is no longer subject to the standard “one primary action type per round” limitation. The Caster who reaches Iron Body is genuinely dangerous in close quarters.

requires.text: Combat Conditioning, Strength or Agility 4+, Heroic tier+

name: Living Conduit
prerequisite_text: Conduit at Veteran tier or above
text: You may redirect any pool damage you take (Mana, Stamina, or Resolve) to an adjacent willing ally at a 2:1 ratio — you take 2 boxes and they take 1. Declare before damage is applied. The ally must consciously accept (free action). This is a sacrifice, not a transfer — both the Conduit and the ally take damage.

name: Overwhelming Power
prerequisite_text: Invoker at Veteran tier or above
text: Once per scene, when you hit with a Power dealing 3+ overage, the target must make a Toughness or Willpower DC equal to 10 + overage or be Stunned until end of their next turn at no additional pool cost.

name: Reality Sculptor
prerequisite_text: Weaver at Veteran tier or above
text: Once per scene, when you use Adaptive Range, you may also change the Power's Area — from single target to Close range burst (or vice versa) at the same Power Level. The area change costs 1 additional Mana.

name: Anti-Magic Field
prerequisite_text: Theorist at Veteran tier or above
text: Once per scene, spend 3 Mana to declare an Anti-Magic Field in your Current Zone. All Powers cast by any character within the zone (including you) add +2 to their pool cost for the rest of the scene. The Field can be dispersed by a successful Dispel against your Intellect.
